I have been farming this land for many years, and for this small plot of maize, I will use what I have learned from my father and the agricultural officers who visit our village. I will apply both organic manure from my animals and some chemical fertilizer to help the maize grow well, because the soil is not as rich as it used to be. I will plant improved seed that I got from the market last season, and I will spray herbicide to control the weeds since I do not have much help. This plot is small enough that my family and I can manage all the work ourselves, and I do not need to pay for irrigation because we rely on the rains here in the North Central.
